intestinal_stem.label: Intestinal stem cell
intestinal_stem.biological_notes: Crypt associated renewal. Paneth contact does not deterministically select symmetric or asymmetric division. Niche support can originate in stroma or a declared boundary.
intestinal_stem.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

transit_amplifying.label: Transit amplifying progenitor
transit_amplifying.biological_notes: Eligible for finite renewal and lineage commitment. Cycle completion and functional maturation are separate.
transit_amplifying.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

enterocyte.label: Enterocyte
enterocyte.biological_notes: Absorptive mature cell. Microvillus function, junction integrity and survival are separate. Mature proliferation is disabled in this model.
enterocyte.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

goblet.label: Goblet cell
goblet.biological_notes: Apical mucus release draws from finite stores. Antigen passage is not professional antigen presentation. Goblet depletion has no single imposed cause.
goblet.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

paneth.label: Paneth cell
paneth.biological_notes: Crypt secretory cell with separate antimicrobial and niche functions. Long residence never makes it immune to injury.
paneth.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

tuft.label: Tuft cell
tuft.biological_notes: Optional sensor for a specifically supported type 2 module. No bacterial or Crohn role is invented from the cell name.
tuft.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

enteroendocrine.label: Enteroendocrine cell
enteroendocrine.biological_notes: Hormone output is subtype specific. A generic cell does not secrete every gut hormone. Direct GLP2 stimulation of stem cells is not implemented.
enteroendocrine.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

m_cell.label: M cell
m_cell.biological_notes: Present only with follicle associated epithelium and a receiving pocket. Not the only route to intestinal antigen sampling.
m_cell.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

best4.label: BEST4 associated absorptive cell
best4.biological_notes: Optional regional annotation; transport physiology requires separate measurements.
best4.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

trophocyte.label: Crypt niche fibroblast
trophocyte.biological_notes: Candidate human niche state, informed partly by mouse trophocyte studies. Its name is not a guaranteed cross atlas subtype match.
trophocyte.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

fibroblast.label: Lamina propria fibroblast
fibroblast.biological_notes: Niche, inflammatory and matrix programs are separate axes. Mature IL1B production is not a universal fibroblast output.
fibroblast.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

bmp_stroma.label: BMP producing stromal cell
bmp_stroma.biological_notes: Spatially supported BMP source. Do not rename every colonic S2 fibroblast as a human villus tip telocyte.
bmp_stroma.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

endothelial.label: Vascular endothelial cell
endothelial.biological_notes: Controls local recruitment permission. Constitutive or induced adhesion depends on vessel state, not a universal inflammation requirement.
endothelial.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

pericyte.label: Pericyte
pericyte.biological_notes: Vessel associated support. Its effect on permeability is a separate optional mechanical assumption.
pericyte.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

enteric_glia.label: Enteric glial cell
enteric_glia.biological_notes: Optional extension with no invented quantitative barrier benefit.
enteric_glia.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

resident_macrophage.label: Resident like macrophage
resident_macrophage.biological_notes: Phagocytosis and microbial killing can occur without large inflammatory output. Baseline IL10 secretion is not mandated by identity.
resident_macrophage.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

inflammatory_monocyte.label: Inflammatory monocyte or macrophage
inflammatory_monocyte.biological_notes: Human inflammatory states have subtype dependent TNF, IL1, IL23 and OSM competence. No universal threefold clearance defect is assigned.
inflammatory_monocyte.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

neutrophil.label: Neutrophil
neutrophil.biological_notes: Movement, finite granule release, uptake and survival are distinct. No proliferation. Lifetime is state dependent, not a fixed maximum.
neutrophil.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

dendritic.label: Conventional dendritic cell
dendritic.biological_notes: Subtype and antigen history are explicit. CD103 is not obligatory for every human cDC2. Exit is not guaranteed return of a new clone.
dendritic.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

th17.label: Previously primed Th17 associated cell
th17.biological_notes: Output requires the initialized competence and activation route. A cell may sustain secretion as a rate while migrating.
th17.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

th1.label: Previously primed Th1 associated cell
th1.biological_notes: IFNG and TNF competence is state specific. De novo priming is outside this patch.
th1.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

regulatory_t.label: Regulatory T cell
regulatory_t.biological_notes: Contact regulation acts through CTLA4 on this cell and CD80/CD86 on the opposing APC. Soluble regulation requires recipient competence.
regulatory_t.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

iel_cd8.label: Previously primed CD8 IEL
iel_cd8.biological_notes: A conservative conventional CD8 IEL model, not all IEL biology. Target recognition requires more than target stress and proximity.
iel_cd8.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

nk.label: NK cell
nk.biological_notes: Activating and inhibitory signals must be combined. No TCR based recognition and no killing from a stress score alone.
nk.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

ilc3.label: ILC3
ilc3.biological_notes: Previously competent innate helper state. IL22 output is not a universal instruction for epithelial proliferation.
ilc3.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

plasma_iga.label: IgA plasma cell
plasma_iga.biological_notes: Existing class and specificity. Apical secretory IgA requires epithelial PIGR transport rather than direct luminal deposition.
plasma_iga.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

plasma_igg.label: IgG plasma cell
plasma_igg.biological_notes: Existing antibody secretion. Fc receptor activation requires relevant immune complexes, not IgG concentration alone.
plasma_igg.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

repair_epithelial.label: Injury associated epithelial state
repair_epithelial.biological_notes: Optional reprogramming extension. CLU expression alone does not license renewed proliferation; origin and functional competence must be established.
repair_epithelial.receptor_policy: Functional competence must be provided separately. Sparse RNA zeros do not prove receptor absence.

initialization.geometry: host supplied physical coordinates, contact graph, epithelial surface and vessel interface
initialization.age: Host supplies elapsed cycle and event age. Do not initialize all cells at birth.
initialization.advanced_states: Specialized functions of optional populations remain disabled without their host modules. Pericytes are present only as vessel support placeholders. Inflamed labels do not guarantee disease dynamics.
